integrity: An explicit order and complete finite verification code reproduce the bound. Historical sources are credited and no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Optimal pair distance is proved only for the binary extended Golay code with cyclic adjacent pairs; the number of optimal orders, larger read windows, other codes, and novelty against unindexed sources are not settled.
title: Sharp cyclic symbol-pair distance of the extended binary Golay code under coordinate permutations
